_comment: The COLD self-hop diff counts on record — the reference range for the self-hop gate (docs/rust-port/00-control.md §3). A cold leg replays nothing and the LLM re-rolls, so the count is a range, not 0; the WARM leg (a copy of the cold leg's cache) must be byte-identical with 0 writes. RE-RECORDED 2026-10-03 for the SCRATCH-base protocol (the default since 2026-10-03; see experiments/034-eval-harness/README.md): the three same-commit cold repeats of 0f338ffa that also set noise-bands.json. The old 92-180 range came from SEEDED-base runs (main-2026-09-18, noise-band-r1..r3 at 76c012b) and no longer describes the default protocol. Judged by experiments/lib/invariants.ts coldRangeVerdict. Only valid for `version`.

names._comment: The names-mode COLD self-hop range: 3 same-commit cold repeats of 111401fe on scratch bases, the same runs that set noise-bands.json's names slot (written by `cargo dev eval bands`, never by hand). A cold leg replays nothing and the LLM re-rolls, so the count is a range; the WARM leg must be byte-identical with 0 writes.
